title: anthoxanthum puelii var. nanum
intro: Anthoxanthum puelii var. nanum, commonly known as Dwarf Velvet Bentgrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Dwarf Velvet Bentgrass include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Velvet Bentgrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
